content.short: iMe Lab is a native messaging smart platform powered by Telegram with Crypto Wallet.
content.description: iMe Lab is a smart platform that combines a Telegram-based messenger, a cryptocurrency wallet, and DeFi tools. It gives Telegram users access to DeFi features, with a user-friendly process and a secure interface for managing cryptocurrencies. iMe Lab also enables mainstream and crypto communities to connect, communicate, and discuss their projects, and the iMe Smart Platform was the first in the industry to incorporate DeFi functionality into its messaging platform.
